fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-05-20 states that the complainant was allegedly struck by a person after a verbal exchange at Roja Park Main Street and later sought medical attention, on 2025-05-20 around 14:35 hrs. Rajesh Mani reported the matter orally at Coimbatore North PS; the contact number given was 9000000409. The complaint mentions Bharathi Raj, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000191, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Dispute reportedly escalated into a physical altercation.
fields.Keywords: assault, altercation, afternoon, CCTV, documents, main street, suspect, mobile number
